name: _meta
script: return "地图视图（暗色）：暗色下控件/署名应为深色面板无白色断层；标记数断言。需联网加载 OSM 瓦片。前置：gen-demo 演示数据。"

name: 02-click-dark
script: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="radiogroup"][aria-label="主题"] button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === '暗'); if (!b) throw new Error('暗色切换按钮缺失'); b.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); if (document.documentElement.dataset.theme !== 'dark') throw new Error('暗色未生效'); 'dark-ok'

name: 04-open-kyoto
script: const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(el => el.textContent.includes('京都')); if (!h) throw new Error('找不到京都'); h.click(); 'ok'

name: 05-switch-map
script: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === '地图'); if (!b) throw new Error('地图 tab 缺失'); b.click(); 'ok'

name: 06-map-dark
script: const markers = document.querySelectorAll('.map-marker'); if (markers.length !== 10) throw new Error('标记数不对（应为 10）: ' + markers.length); 'ok'
